title: Making Luck ep. 99 review: Procession, Steward, Triumph, Treasurer, Swindler

sources.author: Adam Horton and Wandering Winder
sources.note: Making Luck ep. 99, review of the ep. 98 kingdom, 3:36-14:45; a few games played against each other

quality_note: Two top players tested both preview plans head to head and agree the Procession/Triumph deck is best; few games, and they say the deck is far from optimized.

kingdom.setup_notes: Settlers is the split pile Settlers/Bustling Village. Idol is a Fate card, so the Boons deck is used. Apothecary costs a Potion, so Potion is in the Supply.

edition: Kingdom from Adam Horton's ep. 98 description. Colonies not mentioned.
